notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.20
notes.notes:
This is a major gameplay update with a focus on core mechanics. Combat should hopefully feel much tighter, more fun, and more skillful for those who enjoy a bit more than just "walk around and auto-attack everything" (which is a totally fine way to play too, but will require more metagame upgrades to be successful).

I also adjusted balance so it's actually possible to reach the end of the demo (heh).

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] there's now a Golden obelisk that can be completed inside Groat's compound
[*] most items are much more powerful now...
[*] improved hero and enemy animations
[*] item rarities are disabled temporarily
[*] knockback on all items is much more powerful overall
[*] many enemies now have some knockback resistance
[*] offhands can be used much more frequently
[*] offhands fire automatically in your direction of travel
[*] offhands have windup effects to give some time to aim them
[*] press "shift" to make your party stop and focus fire in front of you
[*] there are now glorious gibs when things are hurt/damaged
[*] improved tutorial windows
[*] item upgrade choices include all heroes again when leveling up
[*] more exciting UI for getting item upgrades and heroes
[*] added and improved various sound effects
[/list]
[h3]Fig[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fig's shield creates smaller boulders at first, but much larger when upgraded
[*] Fig's weapon knockbacks are stronger
[*] Fig's jump attack now fully interrupts enemy attacks
[*] Fig does more damage
[*] Fig's starting sword now actually looks wooden
[*] Fig's boulder has a larger impact radius when bouncing, but bounces one less time
[*] Fig's shield will create boulders much more frequently
[/list]
[h3]Min[/h3]
[list]
[*] Min's fireball gets a lot bigger with upgrades
[*] Min's meteor also gets a lot bigger with upgrades
[*] Min's meteor box cooldown is much lower
[*] Min's pyroblaster throweth giant flames at higher upgrades
[/list]
[h3]Han[/h3]
[list]
[*] Han's arrows and bolts now do some knockback
[*] Han's traps are thrown much more frequently and last longer
[*] Han's Feathercut returns as an unlockable offhand with much more damage
[*] Han's animations are improved
[/list]
[h3]Rea[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rea's book of fear is used much more frequently
[*] Rea's book of healio returns as an unlockable offhand with a larger area
[*] fix Rea's leader skill upgrade so it actually increases healing
[/list]
[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] fix heroes getting stuck if chosen too quickly in camp
[*] fix (reluctantly) heroes sometimes standing on chickens instead of mounting
[*] fix followers not helping leader if grabbed or knocked out
[*] fix some cases where more than one UI window could appear at a time
[*] fix a case where a new hero would join when getting a chest
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.19
notes.notes:
Many changes are currently in the works, and this update is the first of several to get everything in shape before an Early Access release.

Heroes now have Adventure Levels! You can level up heroes between runs, earn upgrade points, and choose which adventure upgrades you want each hero to have. This is a way to keep permanently improving each hero.

There's also a whole new hero selection UI plus many small changes and fixes.
[list]
- hero adventure levels: upgrade each hero between runs
- new hero selection experience in camp
- all damage, healing, and health is now higher
- leveling up happens more quickly
- improve performance especially on older graphics cards
- fix accessory bonuses not being applied to heroes who join after you equip the accessory
- many other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.16
notes.notes:
This is a huge gameplay update based on all the feedback gathered during Steam Next Fest. It kinda feels like a different game, hopefully in a good way. Let me know on Discord!

[h3]Why the Changes?[/h3]
I wasn't happy with the core mechanics. I could start to see why as I heard people's feedback, watched some friends play, and of course had a chance to play the game a bunch more myself.

The leader changing wasn't great. Most people weren't changing leaders during a run, myself included, and it makes you feel like you're missing out on something. Now, by only letting you pick a leader at the start of a run, I actually think it makes the game both easier to understand and more replayable. It's fun to start a new run to try a new leader style.

And this was just the tip of the iceberg. My design goal for this game is to create the feeling of "having each others' backs" so I needed a replacement for leader-switching. Now each hero has a unique low-cooldown leader skill. It's basically a "get your party out of trouble" button that behaves very differently for each hero.

Rea can clear a path. Fig can stun large groups. Han can move the party quickly and dominate targets. Min can blast things out of existence. You have to aim this leader skill manually though.

Helms are gone for now. They'll come back, but it was weird to trigger big attacks from something you wear on your head. There are new offhand weapons as a replacement. As leader you trigger offhands manually with right mouse button. Currently your followers use offhands automatically, but this is subject to change.

The recommended movement mode is now to just use your mouse to point and click. Hold left mouse button to keep moving. Press spacebar to use your leader skill. Press right mouse button to use your leader's offhand. You can still use WASD if you want. Controller support coming too.

Partial list of various big changes below.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] all hero skills changed or replaced!
[*] you now only pick your leader at the start of a run, [b]not[/b] during the run
[*] press spacebar to use your leader's special skill (low-cooldown)
[*] heroes move faster and pick things up from further away
[*] hero targeting, animations, and movement should feel much snappier now
[*] you can now move and attack by just mouse-clicking (WASD still works too)
[*] offhand weapons have replaced helms as higher-cooldown special attacks
[*] helms removed for now; they'll return as powerful relics
[*] enemies are generally faster but take longer to hit you
[*] added helper tips for leader skills and offhands
[*] show target's name, health, and level on mouseover
[*] enemies that are too low level will no longer give experience points
[*] all colors rebalanced to help make your heroes and actions more clear
[/list]
[h3]Min[/h3]
[list]
[*] now wields only fire magic
[*] new starter wand
[*] new alternate upgrade weapon: Pyroblaster
[*] new leader skill: fire multiple wand projectiles
[/list]
[h3]Han[/h3]
[list]
[*] arrows are faster and stronger
[*] aim is overall improved
[*] new leader skill: rush forward and then fire arrows quickly
[/list]
[h3]Fig[/h3]
[list]
[*] hit harder overall
[*] new leader skill: jump attack to stun groups
[/list]
[h3]Rea[/h3]
[list]
[*] starter weapon is now melee with low damage, high knockback
[*] new upgrade weapon is a stronger melee staff
[*] new alternate upgrade weapon is a punny mid-range projectile: Canon
[*] new leader skill: fly while knocking enemies away and healing
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.11
notes.notes:
Another big update this week with some major gameplay changes and many fixes.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
The leader hero now auto-attacks by default, so you don't have to keep holding the attack button. BUT. You still have to aim. This brings the mouse and keyboard combat closer to what the controller combat will be like. It frees you up to think more about positioning and choosing the right leader for the right situation.

The second major change is that leader tactics, once you unlock them at camp, are now [b]always on[/b] for the currently active leader. This makes changing leaders much more fun and is one less button/cooldown you have to worry about.

The leader tactics for current heroes are:
[list]
[*] [b]Fig[/b]. Periodically pushes enemies away. Great for reviving fallen allies.
[*] [b]Min[/b]. All heroes leave flames in their wake to damage heroes.
[*] [b]Rea[/b]. Constantly fly and heal.
[*] [b]Han[/b]. Increase movement speed of whole party.
[/list]
These are intended to be quite strong and a tough choice! Let me know how they feel.

[h3]User Interface[/h3]
Many new icons, new window borders, new mouse cursor...most of it is new actually. More to come as well.

[h3]Change List[/h3]
[list]
[*] enable leader auto-attack by default (must still aim though)
[*] leader tactics are now always on for the current leader!
[*] new graphics for user interface
[*] add better sword mesh for Sweeper
[*] add better mesh and animation for Hacker axe
[*] adjust leader auto-attack so ranged heroes can run away more easily
[*] make auto-attack work on target dummy in camp
[*] destroying an obelisk now gives some coins
[*] make obelisk charging more obvious by adding some effects
[*] emphasize when dead heroes reappear at cemeteries
[*] fix priest targeting the wrong things as follower
[*] change item rarities to only happen for new items, not upgrades
[*] fix unselected rarities persisting for future choices
[*] fix cemeteries not becoming available again after resurrections
[*] fix dead heroes not going to nearest cemetery
[*] fix missing delay before ghosts appear at cemetery
[*] fix prayer circle being way too bright / opaque
[*] fix being able to switch leaders to ghosts at cemetery
[*] fix error when changing leaders just before a levelup
[*] fix hero death sounds not playing consistently
[*] fix a freeze that can happen after returning to camp
[*] add "unlocked" text when gate unlocks
[/list]

notes.title: The Road to Release
notes.notes:
I just uploaded a new trailer and screenshots. With a couple months left before Steam Next Fest, the visuals and gameplay are coming together.

Some major changes include:
[list]
[*] A new party bar UI showing your heroes, leader, and abilities
[*] New FX and camera work for special moments (like leveling up)
[*] Our mysterious tormentor, The Hand, is making more appearances
[*] There's a cart you have to defend in the dungeon
[*] Started work on some new heroes you might be able to spot
[/list]

Check out the trailer to see all the changes in action.
